source_notes: Panama City Beach's Granicus archive (https://pcbgov.granicus.com/ViewPublisher.php?view_id=1) posts minutes for only March 2024 in 2024, but each council agenda packet includes the draft minutes of the prior meeting for approval. These 2024 votes were read from those packets (text PDFs, not scanned). Each source_url is the packet in which the minutes appear; the minutes were approved at that next meeting (the approval motions are recorded in the following minutes). Draft minutes may differ slightly from the final approved version.

Roll calls list each member's Aye/No, so by_member comes straight from the minutes. A sitting member missing from a roll call is marked absent. Council before the April 2024 election: Mayor Mark Sheldon, Vice Mayor Paul Casto, Michael Jarman, Mary Coburn, Phil Chester. From April 25, 2024: Mayor Stuart Tettemer, Vice Mayor Michael Jarman, Ethan Register, Paul Casto, Mary Coburn.

Panama City Beach levies no city property tax, so there is no millage vote. The FY2024-25 budget was adopted by Resolution 24-163 at the Sept. 12, 2024 regular meeting; the Sept. 26, 2024 meeting had only a consent agenda.
Amounts come from the resolution titles printed in the agenda packets. Consent items are included only at $250,000 or more and carry the consent motion's roll call.
Two 2025 meetings (Jan. 9 and Feb. 13, 2025) that were also missing from the dataset are included, read the same way. The Jan. 30, 2025 meeting is already in votes.json and was not repeated.
The Aug. 6, 2024 budget workshop minutes record a lighting deferral as a 'voice vote (4-1)' followed by a roll call block; the roll call is used.

votes.summary: The FY2024-25 budget sets General Fund spending at $68,322,300, with law enforcement at $20.5 million, recreation at $16.6 million and fire at $12.6 million. It also sets budgets for the CRA, stormwater, utility, pier, aquatic center and IT funds.
